## What's new

- **Downloads work on mobile data.** Downloads asked for while "Download on Wi-Fi only" was on stayed stuck waiting for Wi-Fi even after the option was turned off. Changing the option now applies straight away, including to downloads already waiting.
- **Downloads page.** See what is downloading right now (with progress for each file), what is still queued, and what failed — retry or remove from there. A second tab lists everything already on the phone, album by album. Open it from Library → Downloads, the Sync page, or the download notification.
- **Download indicator.** A strip above the mini player shows while anything downloads or waits for a connection; tap it to open the Downloads page.
- **Cast.** Play on a Chromecast or speaker group with the new cast button in the full player and on Home. The receiver streams straight from your server, so it has to be able to reach it.
- **Drag and drop.** Long-press a track, album, artist or playlist and drag it onto Play next, Add to queue, Favourite, Sync offline or Delete downloads. Dragging a selected track takes the whole selection along.
- **Player gestures.** Pull the full player down to close it. The mini player has a previous button, and swiping it left or right skips to the next or previous track.

## Install

Download **Kultr-1.1.0.apk** below and open it on your phone. It installs over 1.0.0 and keeps your servers, library and downloads. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
